scope: Read-only resource collection and threshold evaluation only; not build or process-termination admission

sideEffects.host: Read-only CIM/process/pagefile/drive/listening-port inspection, no OS setting change or termination
sideEffects.output: New resource-[a-z0-9-]+.json receipt within packet with exclusive create

reviewFindings: Thresholds are conservative retry admission heuristics, not empirically validated capacity guarantees.
The existing configuration retains compiler work and installed Next runs separate type/lint workers; no source/config/dependency weakening is proposed.
A resource pass alone cannot authorize retry: independent process ownership/port/source/candidate/DB/build recipe checks remain required.
Failure should remain a failed capacity receipt; do not relax thresholds silently or terminate unrelated processes.
Host checks must rerun immediately before costly build, because availability changes.
limitations: This receipt does not assert present capacity or classify exact cause of the prior native OOM.
